title: The Twin-Court Sword Canon
summary: Teaches an adept the jian as a paired weapon whose two edges deliver a single verdict from opposite sides.

title: Treatise on the Hawk Above the Basin
summary: Shows an adept how to circle above an opponent's guard like a hawk over a basin and fall through the gap.

title: The Paired Breath of Blade and Heart
summary: Joins the swordsman's heartbeat and breath to the blade's motion in pairs so that qi and steel never part.

title: River Source to River Mouth
summary: Follows a river from its spring to its mouth and teaches a form of the jian for each stage of its course.

title: The Azure Horizon Sword Lessons
summary: Teaches long-line cuts that stretch toward the horizon and an overhead descent that closes the exchange.

title: Twin Hawks Hunting the Same Prey
summary: Trains two swordsmen to work as a pair of hawks that mark one prey and strike it from two sides.

title: Great Basin Compendium of the Slender Blade
summary: Collects forms that gather an opponent's force as a basin gathers water and then release it in one stroke.

title: Late Autumn Dual-Track Exercises
summary: A rare mortal-tier manual that trains the body track and qi track of the jian together through patient late-season forms.

title: The Oath Beneath the Open Wind
summary: Teaches the jian as an oath spoken to the open wind and kept in every cut and thrust.

title: Plateau Gale Canon
summary: Sets out cuts and charges for fighting in the gale that sweeps the high plateau.

title: Bearing and Return: The Wind-Sworn Jian Forms
summary: Teaches a swordsman to go out on a bearing and come back by the same line with the jian.

title: Sword of the Unwalled Plateau
summary: Teaches the jian on bare high ground where there is nothing to hide behind and nothing to stop a stride.

title: Gale-Riding Jian Practice
summary: Trains a swordsman to lean on a gale and let it carry the blade past a guard.

title: Answering the Wind by Oath
summary: Teaches that every attack must be answered at once and in kind as the oath answers the wind.

title: Plateau Edge Lessons in Falling and Rising
summary: Turns the drop of a plateau edge into forms of descent and climb for the jian.

title: The Oath-Weight Forms
summary: A rare mortal-tier manual that gives the sworn word a physical weight in each stroke of the jian.
